description: This source file exports constants related to an entity with ID 360, and defines a complex module related to graph manipulation and rendering, including functions for copying nodes, handling clusters, layout calculations, and recursive rendering of graphs. It appears to be part of a visualization or diagramming tool, possibly for rendering graph structures with support for clusters and hierarchical layouts.
